full_judgment: 2. Facts, in brief, are that on the basis of the General Diary Entry No.1100 dated 12-11-97, a proceeding was drawn under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, CrPC, registering the same as Non FIR Case No. 793 of 1997 and in the report dated 18-11-1997 filed in the above proceeding, SI Azizur Rahman of Motijheel Police Station, DMP, was shown as the First Party, Manowara Islam, the respondent No.3, and one Abdul Alim were shown as Second Party while the respondent No. 4, along with Nawab Ali Yar Khan and Ali Sarwar were shown as Third Party and the property which was the subject matter of the above dispute was stated to be Holding No. 58/1-A, Purana Paltan, comprising 2.369 kathas of land with a 5-storied building standing thereon and the boundaries of the same were on the north road, on the south road, on the east Holding No.59/1 Purana Paltan and on the west Holding No. 58/1-A. Purana Paltan, and in the said report conclusion was made to the effect that the respondent No. 3 was the claimant of the disputed Holding No. 58/1-A Purana Paltan and the respondent No. 4 was the claimant of Holding Nos. 59 and 59/1, Purana Paltan, and both of them were bent on creating serious breach of peace at any moment and so the said Holding No.58/1-A. Purana Paltan be attached and a receiver be appointed in respect of the said holding. Then on the basis of the above report, the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, by order dated 20-11-1997, drew up a proceeding under section 145 of CrPC in respect of Holding No. 58/1-A and appointed the respondent No. 2 as the receiver of the same and directed him to take over the possession of the disputed property. Then Abdul Alim, one of the Second Party, moved the High Court Division under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure seeking to quash the above proceeding of the Non FIR Case No. 793 of 1997 and after hearing the High Court Division, made the Rule absolute and directed the respondent No. 2 to hand over possession of Holding Nos. 59 and 59/1 Purana Paltan, Dhaka to the respondent No. 4.
